en: Although many think gravity disappears in space, gravity actually exists in the vacuum of space and keeps the Moon orbiting the Earth.
Contrary to the belief that batteries store electricity, a battery actually stores chemical energy that transforms into electrical energy in a circuit.
People often think cold flows into a drink to cool it, but thermal energy actually flows from the warm drink to the cooler ice.
While it is commonly believed that light travels instantly, light actually takes about eight minutes to travel from the Sun to the Earth.
Students often assume sound can travel anywhere, but sound actually requires a physical medium like air and cannot travel through a vacuum.
Many believe magnets only attract iron, but magnets actually attract other ferromagnetic metals like nickel and cobalt as well.
Electrical current is not used up by a bulb, because the bulb merely transforms electrical energy into light and heat.
People think pulleys reduce the total work done, but a pulley actually only reduces the effort force needed to lift a heavy load.
Friction is not just for solid objects rubbing together, as a swimmer also experiences fluid friction, called drag, when moving through water.
A rolling ball does not lose its energy when it stops, because its kinetic energy simply transforms into heat and sound through friction.
The magnetic force of a bar magnet is not strongest in the center, but is actually strongest at its two opposite ends called poles.
An inclined plane does not decrease the total work needed to load a box into a truck, but it reduces the required lifting force.
